rationale: unit:given.single_owner counts immediate owning-reference occurrences rather than distinct paths. lean:Unique/Liveness:WellFormed.owner_count assumes WellFormed and Allocated and concludes References.count object = 1. References concatenates initialized variable entries and all initialized object fields, counting repetitions. That is precisely the stated quantification over allocated objects and storage occurrences; following enclosing objects does not introduce additional entries into this count.
